text:
zoe (People Ops): FYI emily's RSU vest payout for 2026-05-01 shows duplicate withholding. EOR partner (GlobalPay) reported and withheld UK income tax; our US payroll also withheld federal/state. Need to reconcile. @ryan can you confirm what posted on the paystub and remittance status?

ryan (Payroll): Confirmed. US payroll withheld supplemental federal at 22% and CA state at 6% on the RSU gross. GlobalPay remitted UK PAYE on the same payment (they treated it as non-US service period). We have ACH remits for the US tax vendor dated 2026-05-04.

anika (Tax): This is cross-border payroll knot. Two parallel withholdings: UK PAYE + US withholding. Possible fixes: (A) reclaim from UK PAYE (if GlobalPay agrees) or (B) gross-up US off-cycle and seek refund later. Reclaim from HMRC via GlobalPay can take months. Need documentation: GlobalPay remit receipt, RSU settlement statement, and proof of tax residency on payout date.

emily (Employee): I was physically in UK until 2026-04-28 and returned to US 2026-04-30. Equity team routed payout through GlobalPay because of my UK presence. I can get the RSU settlement PDF and my travel docs. Manager supportive of interim make-whole.

kyle (Finance Ops): For cash we can process an off-cycle net reimbursement immediately labeled `EQUITY_DUP_WTH`. Will require JE and manager approval. If reclaim comes later, we'll reverse. Request JE code: `JE-2026-210-equity-dup-wth`.

zoe (People Ops): Manager approved interim make-whole. @ryan please prepare off-cycle estimate and tag tax for follow-up. Include note that GlobalPay contact is ops@globalpay.example.

ryan (Payroll): Preparing off-cycle. Estimate: gross RSU 4,500 GBP, US withholding 990 USD, CA withholding 60 USD (approx). I'll compute exact net after FX and queue off-cycle job. JE requested.

anika (Tax): I'll reach out to GlobalPay for remit confirmation and see if they will process a reclaim or issue refund to employee. If GlobalPay cannot reclaim, we'll coordinate HMRC guidance and consider credit on UK self-assessment or remote reclaim route. Also checking treaty double taxation relief.

kyle (Finance Ops): JE created: JE-2026-210 ("Interim equity duplicate withholding - Emily"). Uploaded docs to finance drive.

payroll-bot: Off-cycle job queued: 2026-05-equity-offcycle job 30221. Requires JE and attachments before processing. https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/30221 :clipboard:

ryan (Payroll): Attaching RSU settlement and GlobalPay remit once received. Will schedule off-cycle as soon as JE is confirmed and tax OKs the approach. Will tag transaction `equity-reclaim-pending`.

emily (Employee): Uploaded settlement statement and boarding pass PDFs to HR folder (equity/emily/2026-05). Thanks team for the quick help. Happy to sign any attestations for reclaim.
